items: A new music mode, on by default: every night has one catchy hook that returns at the big moments (each wave landing, the drum & bass drop after a breakdown, the victory), with each wave's own riff in between
The night starts gentle and opens up into the full rave once the second stump has its soundsystem
Each genre has its own drum kit and groove, with fills, crashes and swing; builds strip the bass and kick away and leave a beat of silence before the drop
The singer sings the hook slowly in the breakdowns, and a sleeping legend's clearing hums it
A brighter, punchier mix, with a clean sub under the bass
The old music is one switch away with ?banger=0
Compressors on the drums and on the whole mix, for punch and to glue it together
A kick drum with more thump, and the bass ducking out of its way
Square-wave leads as the main sound, with a little pulse-wave reply; a few genres keep their own instruments
The singer doubles the hook when it lands, holds soft oohs under the grooves and adds sung stabs
The lead melodies sit lower and quieter, in the groove with the drums
A xylophone and finger snaps drift in and out for a spookier feel
